methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Neuromeka is a public-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $36.5M to date. The valuation landscape for this sector is sparse: while ten robotics peers exist across public and private markets, the comparable universe comprises only one public company (277810.KQ on KOSDAQ) and eight private firms including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. This fragmented peer set reflects the nascent and heterogeneous nature of frontier robotics deployment.

The peer-median triangulation method is not applicable to this analysis. A filtered search for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables yielded insufficient data—zero matches across all three filters. The threshold requirement of three or more datapoints per method could not be met, making a reliable median benchmark impossible to construct. Broadening to an all-sector median would obscure material differences in business model, technology maturity, and addressable market between Neuromeka and peers operating at different stages or scales.

Without sufficient comparable transaction or public market data to triangulate, this valuation cannot be supported by quantitative peer analysis at present. Resolution would require either expansion of the Neuromeka peer universe through detailed financial disclosure from private robotics competitors, or identification of additional public comparables in adjacent automation sectors. The $36.5M capital raised provides a floor for historical investor appetite, but does not alone establish fair value. Further data collection is warranted before a defensible valuation range can be established.
